summary: Hiker fell into a steep, rocky gully near the Pinecliffe railroad crossing along South Boulder Creek; Gilpin County EMTs and Timberline Fire reached the patient partway down, a mountain-rescue-trained firefighter rigged a handline to ferry supplies up and down the near-vertical crack, and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group hauled the litter back up the gully in the dark rather than lowering it to the tracks. Patient transported in stable condition.
location: Gully near Pinecliffe railroad crossing, South Boulder Creek
responding_agency: Timberline Fire Protection District; Gilpin County Ambulance; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Coal Creek Canyon Fire Protection District (mutual aid)
notes: Mountain-Ear says 'Sunday night, August 3'; year pinned to 2014 via weekday check (Aug 3 = Sunday in 2014) and story-ID chronology (adjacent 2014-era story IDs 2323/2334). Patient had reportedly been fishing with a friend and slipped.
